en: Black‑and‑white view of a ceremonial military parade on a city street. A long formation of uniformed soldiers in dress uniforms, helmets, white gloves and saber belts stands at attention facing the camera. Behind them are multi‑story European‑style buildings with balconies and businesses. Crowds watch from the sidewalks and upper‑floor windows. Signboards in Spanish and English advertising professional services and an electrical construction company are visible on the façades.
